## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any manual verification that remains.

## Screenshots

Include before and after screenshots for user-interface changes, or write
`Not applicable`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactors.
- [ ] Tests cover stable and important behavior where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation and user-facing text are updated when needed.
- [ ] No secrets, private source code, personal data, or transcripts are included.
- [ ] I agree to the contribution terms in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
